# saml-cipher

> An interactive, user-friendly Python cryptographic toolkit supporting classical symmetric/asymmetric ciphers and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC: X25519 + ML-KEM-768).

saml-cipher is a pure Python cryptographic utility designed for practical file and text encryption. It provides a guided terminal interface via `questionary`, lowering the barrier for cryptographic operations. The repository features modern cryptography (AES-GCM-SIV, X448, RSA-4096 with ChaCha20-Poly1305) as well as quantum-resistant hybrid KEM algorithms designed to safeguard data against quantum cryptanalysis (Shor's algorithm, Q-Day).

## Core Modules & Supported Cryptography

- [x25519mlkem768/](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/x25519mlkem768): Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) hybrid key encapsulation (X25519 + ML-KEM-768) paired with ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD. Quantum-resistant, side-channel attack hardened, and optimized for mobile devices.
- [aes_gcm/](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/aes_gcm_siv): AES-GCM authenticated encryption with 128, 192, and 256-bit keysresistance.
- [rsa/](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/rsa): RSA 4096-bit encryption with PKCS#1 OAEP and ChaCha20-Poly1305 hybrid file encryption (`rsa-file-encrypt.py` / `rsa-file-decrypt.py`).
- [x448/](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/x448): High-security elliptic-curve key exchange (Curve448) coupled with ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption.
- [des/](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/tree/main/des): Legacy 64-bit DES in CTR mode (provided strictly for educational/demonstration purposes; cryptographically insecure).

## Quickstart & Usage

- [requirements.txt](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/blob/main/requirements.txt): Runtime dependencies (`cryptography`, `pycryptodome`, `questionary`).
- [README.md](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/blob/main/README.md): Repository documentation in Traditional Chinese with CLI interface screenshots.

### Execution Pattern
1. Install dependencies: `pip install -r requirements.txt`
2. Run any algorithm interactively: `python <directory>/<script_name>.py`

## Security & Operational Context

- **Interactive CLI**: Driven by `questionary` interactive prompts; requires no complex command-line arguments.
- **Test Credentials**: Sample keys and test vectors use the passphrase `test` (intended for testing only; do not use in production).
- **Quantum Threat Mitigation**: Recommended for sensitive data protection against "Harvest Now, Decrypt Later" (HNDL) scenarios using the `x25519mlkem768` hybrid suite.

## Optional & References

- [Community Discussions](https://github.com/Samlan9/saml-cipher/discussions/1): Feedback, bug reports, and discussion board.
- [NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM)](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/203/final): Official standard for Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism.
- [RFC 7748 (Curve25519 and Curve448)](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7748): Elliptic Curves for Security.
